goal: A re-driven landing completes only after a fresh held-out gate evaluation passes against the content landing, with gate failures re-parking, counting toward the redrive bound, and failing closed, while ungated redrives land exactly as today.

relevant: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_orchestrate.py -- redrive_parked_landings and the landing-gate evaluation seam; module is over 800 lines, use serena symbols
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_gate_verdict_record.py -- keep green; the re-evaluation must flow through this same record path
references: .flywheel/audits/00073-run-decision-record-verify.md -- execution addendum: the live bypass this closes
constraints: Every landing re-attempt gets a fresh gate evaluation (spec D-1), reusing the same evaluation and verdict-record path as first attempts (spec D-2) -- do not fork a second evaluation path
If the redrive entry point's signature changes, update every caller and test in this same change
Gate evaluation errors fail closed on the re-attempt path exactly as on the first attempt
Commit the change (Conventional Commits) before reporting done
non_goals: Do not weaken, delete, or modify existing assertions in the pinned test files
Do not change what the gate checks, the registration format, or the human-review queue mechanics
Do not read or write under .flywheel/verification/
edge_cases: A gate failure on a re-attempt must consume a redrive-bound attempt and route to human review at the bound (criterion 7)
An unexecutable oracle at redrive time must not land (criterion 5)
A redrive with no held-out source configured must behave byte-for-byte as today (criterion 6)
The fresh verdict record must carry the re-evaluation's own grader output -- reusing the first evaluation's record must fail the behavior test (criterion 3)
